title: Scalar and exact-derived open-sequence comparison data
statement: Let C have object universe c and morphism universe v, let k=max(c,v,r), suppose C is essentially small in k, and let J be a Grothendieck topology, U an object, and B_n a tower of commutative ring sheaves with adjacent maps. Fix an ordinary open datum O [def-pur-sequence-site-open-data]. Define O.Scalars to require, for every commutative ring R in any universe and every natural family of ring maps R→B_n(X) commuting with every composite coefficient map, that multiplication by each t∈R gives endomorphisms f of every localized system M and g of O.Jfun(M) having exactly these sectionwise formulas and satisfying O.Jfun(f)=g. Define O.derivedLevel and O.coefficients.derivedComparison using termwise exact localization [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]: compose the inverse standard composition factor, the localization of the ordinary natural isomorphism, and the standard composition factor. Define O.DerivedTransitions to require the ordinary transition equation after these replacements on every derived system, retaining the localization of O.coefficientRestriction. Define SequenceOpenDerivedAdjunction(O) to be an adjunction D(O.Jfun)⊣D(O.L) whose unit at Q(K), composed with D(O.L) of the Jfun factor and then the L factor, equals Q of the termwise ordinary unit; and whose counit, precomposed with D(O.Jfun) of the inverse L factor, equals the Jfun factor followed by Q of the termwise ordinary counit. These are the five existing definitions, relocated without changing names, binders or bodies.

mathlib_searches.verdict: Use project direct-sum adjunction and localization infrastructure.

mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits: SheafOfModules.restrictScalars and its object/map/additive formulas; PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars. No normalized open-extension package.
mathlib_searches.verdict: The sectionwise formulas support the construction; no complete match.

mathlib_searches.results: 8 hits: sheafificationAdjunction, overMapPushforwardAdj, overPushforwardOverAdj, pushforwardPushforwardAdj and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction.
mathlib_searches.verdict: These are component adjunctions; use them via the existing project normalization.

mathlib_searches.results: 25 hits including Localization.liftNatTrans_app, comp_liftNatTrans, localization of adjunctions. No complete open sequence comparison.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use localization naturality and its standard factorization equations.
